facts.fact: SARS says its artificial intelligence fraud-risk detection and verification work in tax refunds is operating, with the report crediting it with preventing the outflow of over R417 billion in impermissible refunds since 2020.
SARS reports that its AI fraud-risk detection and verification work prevented the outflow of over R417 billion in impermissible refunds over the 2020-2025 plan period.
